title: Mitti De Baway Episode 1 Recap (Roman Urdu/Hindi)
elevenlabs_notes: Generate 8 separate MP3 files (part1.mp3 through part8.mp3) by pasting each part's spoken_text into ElevenLabs. Drop them into elevenlabs_audio/ and run merge_audio.bat.

parts.label: PART 1 (00:00 - 01:00)
parts.spoken_text: Ek aurat kaale kapdon mein mannat ka roza rakh kar kisi ki maut ka intezar kar rahi hai, aur usi lamhe ek aisa qaidi jail se bahar nikalta hai jise dekh kar poori jail usay kisi badshah ki tarah salaam karti hai. Lekin bahar nikalte hi qabristan mein us par goliyon ki baarish ho jaati hai. Aakhir kaun hai yeh aurat, aur is aadmi ke saath iska kya purana hisaab baqi hai? Aaj ki kahani hai Mitti De Baway ki, jahan Punjab ki zarkhez mitti sirf faslein nahi ugati, balkay yahan ishq ki daastanein bhi janam leti hain aur khoon mein doobi dushmaniyan bhi. Yahan mohabbat ho ya nafrat, dono dil ki gehrai se nibhayi jaati hain. Kahani shuru hoti hai saal unnees sau ninnanve se. Jail ki andheri rahdari mein ek shakhs kaale libaas mein chal kar aa raha hai. Yeh hai Iqbal Channan, jise poori duniya Baala ke naam se jaanti hai.

parts.label: PART 2 (01:00 - 02:00)
parts.spoken_text: Jail ki salakhon ke peeche khade saare qaidi Baala ko dekh kar naare laga rahe hain, jaise koi aam mujrim nahi balkay koi azeem hero riha ho raha ho. Doosri taraf manzar badalta hai aur hum dekhte hain Bilqees Bano ko, jise kabhi sab Billo kehte thay. Kaale libaas mein lipti Billo apni dargah mein haath utha kar dua maang rahi hai, aur uske gird darjanon auratein adab se sir jhukaye baithi hain. Idhar jail ka bhari lohe ka darwaza khulta hai aur Baala azaad hawa mein qadam rakhta hai. Bahar uska chhota bhai Jooji aur uske wafadar log usay gale laga kar khushiyan manaate hain. Lekin Baala seedha ghar jaane ke bajaye qabristan chala jaata hai, jahan woh apne pyaron ki qabr par paani daal kar fatiha padhta hai. Udhar dargah mein jab khadima Billo ke liye khana laati hai, to woh sard lehje mein kehti hai, wapas le jao, mera mannat ka roza hai, aur yeh mannat poori hone par hi khulega.

parts.label: PART 3 (02:00 - 03:00)
parts.spoken_text: Abhi Baala qabr ke paas khada dua kar hi raha hota hai ke qabristan ka sannata achanak barood mein badal jaata hai. Qabron ke peeche se hatyarband hamla-awar nikalte hain aur seedha Baala par kalashnikov taan lete hain. Baala chillata hai ke Jooji yahan se bhaag jao, magar wafadar bhai apne bade bhai ko akela chhodne se inkaar kar deta hai. Achanak goliyon ki ghan-garaj se poora qabristan goonj uthta hai. Theek usi lamhe Billo apni safaid dargah ke bahar khamosh khadi hai, uski aankhon mein na koi darr hai na koi reham. Qabristan mein ek ke baad ek goli chalti hai. Jooji khoon mein latpath ho kar mitti par gir padta hai, aur phir Baala khud bhi zakhmi ho kar zameen par dher ho jaata hai. Udhar dargah ke sehan mein khadi Billo sukoon se apni aankhein band kar leti hai, jaise qabristan mein behne wale khoon ne aakhirkar uski barson purani mannat poori kar di ho.

parts.label: PART 4 (03:00 - 04:00)
parts.spoken_text: Camera qabristan ke upar uthta hai aur kahani kai saal peeche flashback mein chali jaati hai, us daur mein jab Baala ke haath mein bandook nahi thi aur na us par kisi qatl ka ilzaam tha. Yeh woh waqt hai jab Iqbal Channan ek shareef aur izzatdar kapde ka tajir hota hai. Uska chhota bhai Jooji hansi khushi motor cycle chalata hua dukan aur ghar sambhalta hai. Ghar mein Iqbal ki biwi Zareena usay apna purana wada yaad dilati hai ke usay poore chaar tolay ke sone ke kade chahiye. Iqbal narmi se kehta hai ke pehle meri behan Kausar ke nikah ki tareekh pakki ho jaye, phir uske zewaron ke saath tumhare kade bhi ban jayenge. Jab Zareena shikwa karti hai to Iqbal saaf kehta hai ke main sirf tumhara shohar nahi hoon, apne behan bhaiyon ka maa bhi hoon aur baap bhi, aaj jo kuch hai sab unhi ki badolat hai.

parts.label: PART 5 (04:00 - 05:00)
parts.spoken_text: Agle manzar mein Iqbal aur Jooji apni kapde ki dukan par hote hain, jahan achanak ilaqay ke bhatta-khor ghunde aa dhamakte hain. Jooji ka para charh jaata hai aur woh unhein suna deta hai ke har mahine ki pehli tareekh ko poora hissa bhej diya jaata hai, ab dobara muft ki kamai khane kyun aa gaye? Baat haathapai tak pahunch jaati hai aur ghunde Jooji ko dhamki dete hain. Tabhi Iqbal beech mein aa kar maamla thanda karta hai, unke buzurg se adab se baat karta hai aur Jooji ko rok deta hai. Baad mein jab Jooji ghusse se kehta hai ke aap unke peeche mujhe daant rahe hain, to Iqbal use samjhata hai ke hum yahan karobar karne baithe hain, badmashi karne nahi. Hamein Kausar ki shaadi aur agle saal hajj karna hai, kisi se dushmani nahi chahiye. Kise pata tha yeh aman pasand aadmi ek din sab se khatarnak dushman ban jayega.

parts.label: PART 6 (05:00 - 06:00)
parts.spoken_text: Idhar mohallay mein achanak halchal mach jaati hai jab safaid gaadiyon ka ek bada qafila Shah sahab ki haveli ke bahar aa kar rukta hai. Mohallay ki auratein bhaag kar dekhti hain aur pata chalta hai ke mashhoor buzurg Wadde Sarkar khud Shahon ke ghar tashreef laye hain. Doosri taraf Iqbal jab ghar aata hai to apne bete Ibrahim ko gaane sunte dekh kar barham ho jaata hai, kyunkay usay hamesha darr rehta hai ke kahin log uske khandan ke purane bhaand peshe ka taana na maar dein. Zareena muskurate hue kehti hai ke Ibrahim bilkul apne chacha Jooji ki tarah ziddi hai, kaash mujhe pehle pata hota to main usay Wadde Sarkar se dam karwa laati. Udhar Shahon ki haveli mein Wadde Sarkar unki nayi bahu ki ibadat aur parhezgari ki tareef karte hain aur usay khabardar karte hain ke is raaste par chalne walon ke saamne badi aazmaishein aati hain, magar ghabrana mat, kyunkay wahi aazmaishein tumhein kundan bana dengi.

parts.label: PART 7 (06:00 - 07:00)
parts.spoken_text: Shahon ki haveli ki yeh baat agle hi pal Iqbal ke sehan mein toofan le aati hai. Zareena baaton mein Iqbal ko batati hai ke Wadde Sarkar ne Shahon ki bahu par khaas inayat ki hai, aur ab mohallay ki saari ladkiyan usi nek aurat se Quran padhti hain. Iqbal aam andaaz mein sun raha hota hai, magar tabhi Zareena uska naam leti hai, Bilqees, wahi Bilqees Bano jo Wazirabad se Shahon ke ghar byah kar aayi hai. Yeh naam sunte hi Iqbal ke chehre ka rang ud jaata hai aur haath wahin tham jaate hain. Woh bina khana khaye khamoshi se uth kar bahar nikal jaata hai aur Zareena hairan reh jaati hai. Bechain qadmon se purani galiyon mein chalte hue Iqbal achanak ruk jaata hai jab safaid chadar mein lipti ek aurat Shahon ki haveli mein daakhil hoti hai. Upar khidki par wahi Bilqees khadi hai jiska naam aaj bhi Iqbal ka sukoon chheen leta hai.

parts.label: PART 8 (07:00 - 08:00)
parts.spoken_text: Lekin asli jhatka abhi baqi tha. Shahon ki haveli ke andar Bilqees ka shohar Nazeer Shah khamosh baitha hai jab ghar ki ek ladki poochti hai ke kal aap ki shaadi ki saalgirah hai, bhabhi ko kya tohfa denge? Nazeer ka chehra sakht ho jaata hai aur woh sard lehje mein kehta hai ke tum ab bachi nahi rahi, achhi tarah jaanti ho ke hamari shaadi ki saalgirah ke din hi Bilqees ke bhai ki barsi hoti hai. Yeh ek jumla poori kahani ko khoon aur raaz se jod deta hai. Raat dhalne par Iqbal khamosh ghar lautta hai, apni soti hui biwi aur bache ko dekhta hai, aur andheri chhat par ja kar maazi ki yaadon mein kho jaata hai. Wazirabad ki purani hansi, jawan Billo aur Baala ka adhoora ishq, sab uski aankhon mein aag ban kar jalne lagta hai. Aakhir Bilqees ke bhai ke qatl ka raaz kya hai? Agli qist mein sab khulega. [end]
